dateNavigator.$description: Steps a calendar view through time and names the period on screen: ‹ previous · › next · Today, then the period itself ("Oct 25 – 31, 2026", "October 2026", "Thu, Oct 29, 2026") as a ghost trigger that opens the DS Calendar to jump to any date. One unit at a time — day, week (Sunday-first) or month — set by the view it drives. The three buttons ARE Button secondary base (icon-only for the arrows), never re-declared; what it owns is the arrangement and the period trigger. Two layouts: inline (controls, then the period — desktop) and split (the period first, the controls at the far end — a phone row). Added 2026-11-03 for Schedule (user: "there's no such component for the calendar — worth adding to the DS"); Student Scheduling's Calendar header is the same job and should move onto it.

gap.$description: 8px between the three buttons — Button group spacing.

periodGap.$description: 8px between the buttons and the period trigger (inline layout; its own 8px padding makes the visual gap 16).

gap.$description: 4px between the label and its chevron.

radius.$description: Button's radius — the trigger reads as a ghost button.

label.$description: 18/600 — the period is the view's heading.

labelPhone.$description: 16/600 under 768px, so the split row fits beside three buttons.

hoverBg.$description: Button ghost's hover fill (its focus ring is Button ghost's too, resolved from button.tokens.json).
